title.narrative: To contribute towards the NHSP targets of 90-90-90 and equitable access to HIV services. - Nepal (16-Mar-2018-15-Mar-2021)

description.narrative: Nepal, HIV, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: To contribute towards the NHSP targets of 90-90-90 and equitable access to HIV services.. The objectives of this program are: Accelerate and scale up comprehensive HIV prevention programmes among PWID, MSM, MSW and TG people.. Expand access to and coverage of quality, equitable and gender-sensitive HIV diagnosis, treatment, care and retention through enhanced case management with strengthened health and community systems.
